regimeSub: Waller muddies hike path pre-NFP as 10Y holds 4.79%, Brent breaches $96 on Iran supply fears.
themes: Fed Governor Waller (Sep 4) 'muddies outlook' on September hike per PBS → counters Warsh Jackson Hole hawkishness; market consensus now split as Axios reports 'not so fast on rate hikes' (Sep 3); 10Y steady at 4.79%

August NFP preview dominates: CNBC (Sep 3) flags 'jobless summer' with 56K consensus (Biggo Finance Sep 4) → one-time factors may produce negative print per Seeking Alpha; high-stakes for September FOMC hike decision

Brent clears $96 (+$0.29) as Iran war premium persists despite June interim peace deal → WTI $91.93; gold surges to $4519 (+$60) on dual inflation/haven bid; Indian 10Y breaks 7% on global bond rout (ET Sep 2)

BOK decoupling holds: Governor Shin's 3.00% rate with 3.3% growth forecast (Aug 27) → KRW firms to 1355 (-3) as Businesskorea confirms BOK 'won't automatically follow US moves'; KOSPI +9pts to 6661 on HBM rotation
